_comment: Stage 1 agronomic priors (eggplant/brinjal, greenhouse). Sources: README_EGGPLANT.md. Several fields are estimates flagged LOW confidence where no dedicated eggplant study was found (RH band, CO2, DLI) -- see confidence notes before using in production without field validation.

rh._comment: No dedicated growing-stage RH study found for eggplant -- LOW confidence, reasoned from Solanaceae family similarity to tomato pending field validation.

soil_moisture._comment: Capacitive sensor %, calibrated 0 = bone dry, 100 = saturated. Estimate: Karam et al. 2011 found even 80% of field capacity cut yield 12%, so nudged higher than all three other crops -- needs field calibration, source used a weight-based FC scale, not the capacitive scale here.

co2._comment: No eggplant-specific enrichment study found -- carried over from the general tomato/cucumber/capsicum convergence, LOW-MEDIUM confidence.

light._comment: No total-DLI target found -- Terlizzese et al. 2025 tested only SUPPLEMENTAL DLI (8.64 mol/m2/day on top of natural light), not a total daily target, so this figure is a conservative carryover from tomato, not eggplant-specific. LOW confidence, verify against your sensor's calibration.

actuator_rates._comment: Unchanged from the tomato profile -- these describe fan/heater/mister hardware, not the crop.
